name: @markgit/tool-spec
description: Open manifest schemas for tools, harnesses, MCP servers, and agent skills listed on Markgit

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const f of ['markgit-tool.schema.json','markgit-harness.schema.json','markgit-mcp.schema.json','markgit-skill.schema.json']) JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f))"
